pages.text:
## Meet Jerry
Born and raised in rural Kansas, Senator Jerry Moran understands the meaning of a hard day’s work and the importance of Kansas conservative values - God, country, family, and freedom. Jerry holds these values near and dear to his heart and continues to rely on them.
We need your help to defend conservative values in Washington. Will you contribute any amount today? Thank you for your support!

pages.title: Issues - Jerry Moran
pages.text:
## Kansas Values. Kansas Strong.
Born and raised in rural Kansas, Senator Jerry Moran understands the meaning of a hard day’s work and the importance of Kansas values - God, country, family, and freedom. Jerry holds these values near and dear to his heart and continues to rely on them.
## Delivering Real Results for Kansans
Jerry breaks through the dysfunction in Washington, D.C. and delivers lasting results for Kansans. As a bipartisan leader in the U.S. Senate, Jerry had the third most bills signed into law last Congress and was ranked as one of the most effective U.S. Senators by the Center for Effective Lawmaking.
## Inflation is Breaking our Budgets & Destroying our Economy
Joe Biden's inflation is the worst in forty years. And it’s costing Americans more money every day. A new study shows that the average American family will now pay over $3,000 more this year -- just because of inflation. Jerry is fighting to help Kansas families with common-sense solutions. Food, gas, mortgages – it all costs too much. It’s breaking our budgets and destroying our economy.
Jerry knows that partisan politics will never lower your grocery bill. But common sense solutions can put us on the road to recovery – stop the wasteful spending, unleash American energy and rebuild our manufacturing base.
## Keeping Our Promise to Veterans
As the Chairman and Ranking Member of the Senate Committee on Veterans’ Affairs, Jerry worked with President Trump and President Biden to lead significant legislative accomplishments to care for our nation’s veterans – from community care to mental health care to adaptive housing to the PACT Act.
This summer, Jerry introduced, advocated for, and worked across the aisle to pass the PACT Act so that all-generations of veterans who were exposed to burn pits receive the care and benefits they deserve.
## It is Time to Unleash American Energy
Joe Biden's decision to drain our emergency oil supply – already at its lowest level in four decades – is a short-sighted and dangerous choice that endangers our energy security at a critical time of global uncertainty.
It is time to unleash American energy production in order to lower prices, support American jobs and decrease our reliance on foreign adversaries for our energy. Jerry supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy that utilizes domestic sources of oil, natural gas and coal; renewable energy sources like biofuels, wind, solar, geothermal and hydropower; and the use of nuclear energy.
Our nation has the ability to be energy independent again, and Kansas has a role to play in accomplishing that mission.
## Backing the Blue
Jerry has fought against the “defund the police” movement and acted to provide law enforcement a pay raise and the tools they need to protect our communities. As the top Republican on the committee that funds the Department of Justice, Jerry has led the charge to back the blue and defend our first responders.
## Advocating for Kansas Agriculture
There’s no truer saying than “farmers feed the world.” As a lifelong Kansan, Jerry understands the importance of our agriculture industry. That’s why he’s helped write farm bills that support our farmers, ranchers, and producers.
Jerry will always advocate for the farmers, ranchers, and producers who make up our Kansas agriculture industry.
## Championing Life
Throughout his entire career in public service, Jerry has used his voice and his vote to defend the unborn and protect life at all stages. Jerry was instrumental in electing a Republican Senate majority that went on to confirm hundreds of federal judges and multiple Supreme Court justices who respect the Constitution and every American’s inherent right to life. He is proudly endorsed by Kansans For Life PAC, the leading pro-life grassroots organization in the state.
Now, Joe Biden and Democrats in Congress are determined to remove the longstanding Hyde Amendment and use taxpayer dollars to fund abortions in the United States and abroad. Jerry opposes any attempt by Washington politicians to use American tax dollars on abortion and will continue to fight for the rights of the unborn.
## Securing Our Southern Border
We have a humanitarian, public health and national security crisis happening at our Southern border. As the lead Republican of the committee that provides resources to the Department of Justice, Jerry has visited the southern border on multiple occasions to hear from law enforcement on the ground and witness the humanitarian and national security crisis.
Joe Biden continues to be absent in this crisis. We must prioritize additional border security measures that include a physical barrier and investment in new technology. We must also enforce our immigration laws and work to reform our immigration system so we reward those that follow the law and disincentive illegal crossing.
## Listening to Kansans
Jerry makes it a priority to return home each week to listen and connect with Kansans. Traveling nearly 200,000 miles across Kansas since 2017, Jerry won the Senate MVP Award by Town Hall Project for holding more town halls than any other U.S. Senator.

pages.title: Priorities
pages.text:
Kansas First, Kansas Always
## Standing up to Democrats — and Republicans — who Spend Recklessly, Borrow Continually and Tax Repeatedly.
Jerry Moran has consistently fought to reduce spending, promote a Balanced Budget Amendment, and has opposed increasing our tax burden.
Jerry Moran has consistently gone against the tide in Washington and fought Congress’ tax-and-spend problem. He thinks Congress is hemorrhaging money at an alarming rate and must be reminded that spending trillions of dollars — that we do not have — undermines economic recovery today and the future of our children and grandchildren who will have to pay these crippling debts. He is committed to opposing reckless spending and reining in big government in a fiscally responsible way to help Kansas families and businesses.
Jerry Moran knows that bad fiscal policy can come from both political parties — which is why he has not been afraid to stand up to the leadership of either political party on spending, taxes and debt.
He was one of 17 (out of 435) members of Congress to vote against every stimulus and bailout proposed by either political party. Jerry was even one of the first Republicans to oppose the use of earmarks in spending bills.
He also opposed his own party’s leadership on the 2014 Continuing Resolution Omnibus because he thought that the CROminbus was an unnecessary surrender to President Obama and the Democrats following the Republican takeover of the Senate a month earlier. He was one of only 12 Republican senators who tried to stall or defeat the $1.1 trillion bill.
Jerry is a proven tax-cutter, having voted for lower taxes more than 200 times in Congress, including voting to repeal the death tax, a harmful and unfair tax hurting Kansas’ farmers and small businesspeople. Senator Moran is also the lead sponsor of the FAIR Tax reform package in the United States Senate.
## Leading Voice for Kansas Agriculture
Jerry Moran has been a trusted champion of Kansas farmers and ranchers. He has stood up to Obama’s EPA regulations that hurt our family farms.
When Republicans captured the Senate majority for the 114th Congress, Jerry Moran was appointed chairman of the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture.
Growing up in Western Kansas taught Jerry Moran that government can make the lives of Kansas farmers and ranchers more difficult by creating uncertainty and throwing needless regulations, taxes, fees, and restrictions our way. Jerry believes that regulators and bureaucrats need to let farmers and ranchers be the responsible stewards of the land that they always have been.
Most recently, Senator Moran battled the Obama Administration on the listing of the lesser prairie chicken as a threatened species and fought the proposed WOTUS rule. He aggressively stood up to the EPA and said it couldn’t regulate farm dust, and successfully opposed the government’s attempt to tell us our kids couldn’t work on our family farms. He took on the head of the USDA, regarding its foolish promotion of “meatless Mondays.”
## Consistent Conservative Who Stands Firm Against President Obama’s Executive Overreach
Jerry Moran has cosponsored legislation to fully repeal Obamacare, and aggressively worked to stop President Obama’s executive order to grant amnesty to millions of illegal immigrants.
Jerry Moran has fought the president’s agenda from the outset. As a member of the House of Representatives, he was the first representative to file legislation to repeal Obamacare. In the Senate, he continues to fight to repeal Obamacare.
Jerry Moran has been consistent in his opposition to granting blanket amnesty to illegal immigrants. He has consistently opposed legislation granting driver’s licenses or special benefits to those who enter our country illegally. Numbers USA, a leading group supporting the enforcement of the rule of law for immigration matters, has given the Senator an A- rating.
Jerry Moran was an early opponent of President Obama’s nomination of Loretta Lynch to be Attorney General primarily because he was unconvinced she would stand up to the president’s continual disregard for our Constitution.
## A Trusted Protector and Proven Defender of the Second Amendment
Jerry Moran consistently receives an A rating from the National Rifle Association for his record protecting our fundamental right to keep and bear arms.
He is a champion of the Second Amendment and has been a leader of the opposition to the U.N. Arms Trade Treaty. Jerry Moran has spoken out repeatedly against the Obama Administration’s attempts to reverse U.S. policies, abandon its own red line negotiation principles, and admit publicly the treaty’s dangerous ambiguity. He believes we must reject this treaty, which fails to exempt civilian firearms from its scope, and instead uphold the fundamental individual rights of Americans.
During his time in the Senate, he has also introduced legislation to prohibit taxpayer money from being used by the Department of Homeland Security to purchase ammunition without presenting the necessary justification to Congress. Additionally, he has fervently supported legislation to support concealed carry reciprocity – allowing law-abiding citizens to exercise their fundamental right to self-defense while traveling or temporarily living away from home.
While much needs to be done to prevent violent crime in our nation, more restrictions on responsible, law-abiding firearm owners are not the answer. We must redouble our efforts to enforce all existing gun laws, which are extremely effective in protecting law-abiding citizens from each other, and use our legal power to prosecute criminals who misuse firearms to the fullest extent of the law.
## Cherishing Life. Safeguarding our Freedoms. Reclaiming our American Values.
Jerry Moran’s commitment to the sanctity of life, defense of religious freedom and safeguarding our freedoms from attack has never wavered.
Jerry Moran is, and always has been, pro-life. He believes life is precious and deserves our respect and protection. Science reveals that each human life begins at conception, and Jerry believes the right to life guaranteed by the Constitution is vested in each human being. This right is sacred.
He was one of the first members of the Senate to co-sponsor legislation to ban the use of taxpayer dollars to fund Planned Parenthood following the ghastly revelations that they were selling fetal tissue from aborted babies. Jerry publicly called on Senate Republican leadership to advance the legislation quickly and make it a top priority for the Republican Senate.
Jerry Moran has fought to make certain Americans are not forced to violate their religious beliefs or face penalties if they refuse to do so. He believes that our courts should not overstep their bounds by inserting themselves in important policy debates best left to the democratic process, not judicial fiat, and has refused to support the confirmation of judges who do not reflect that philosophy.
It’s time for us to say no to Washington mandates and overreach because far too often they are trampling on our special way of life. States’ rights are guaranteed in our Constitution and must be upheld.
## Defender of our Nation’s Veterans
Jerry Moran has worked to hold the Obama Administration accountable for serious problems at the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), problems which have gravely impacted veterans’ access to quality health care. He has been a tireless advocate of the Veterans Access, Choice and Accountability Act.
Jerry Moran understands how important it is for us to honor the commitment of our nation’s veterans by supporting our military personnel. As a member of Senate Veterans’ Affairs Committee, he has been and will remain on the forefront of the effort to reform the VA and hold its leadership accountable. Our veterans deserve a VA that is worthy of their service and sacrifice.
Especially in a diverse and rural state like ours, Jerry Moran has sought to create new avenues of access to health care for our nation’s veterans. When many service members were forced to drive hundreds of miles or wait weeks, if not months, for care, Jerry proposed legislation to allow veterans who lived more than 40 miles from a VA hospital or Community-Based Outpatient Clinic, or who faced a delay of more than 30 days, to seek care with their local doctor.
